name: io.github.adepoco/clearrun-mcp
title: ClearRun
description: Scores AI answers for honesty calibration. Not a fact-checker.

environmentVariables.name: CLEARRUN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for clearrun_score, clearrun_evaluate, and clearrun_chat. Those tools need it. A signed-in free account with a verified email can create one free developer key. It returns the free verdict. The default cap is 2 requests a second, 6 a minute, 30 an hour, and 40 a day. On Pro, Business, and Enterprise, API access must be turned on. clearrun_verify does not read this variable. Create a key at https://api.clearrun.net/account/keys or run npx @clearrun/cli login.
